training: Full Train pure restoration, not minibatch continuation. Load the same V1global51 public task checkpoint and fresh S2 adapter initialization; keep TabM frozen. ONLY paired centered-direction cosine loss updates the adapter. No recognition or quantity-loss gradient, no classifier forward in a training step. Same row class budgets, online AWGN schedule/seed/order, two fixed views, normalization, adapter optimizer and20epoch budget as completed F1.
reference: Same Train mixture before additional AWGN, preserving native background and all Double sources. Reference only supplies the restoration target. No clean/count/SNR input during inference.
selection: Unchanged Val protection and epoch score: source protection first, then mean5/0ACC,mean5/0Single,rawACC; actual epochs1..20. Labels are used for existing class budgets and validation/evaluation, not a recognition training loss.
test_policy: Only if task and mechanism Val gates pass, evaluate six observed-input Test conditions with one sealed checkpoint. No automatic joint adaptation or architecture changes.
